textoCompleto:
Manchester Triage System

EMERGENCY TRIAGE

Systematic clinical decision-making method (cascade) for determining medical priority.
Patient Data

Fill out for the Medical Record/PDF Report

2. Discriminators (Signs and Symptoms)
Select the options that apply to the patient's condition.

Care Priority

Triage Log

Suggested NANDA Diagnoses
Based on chief complaint and discriminators.

Score Interpretation

Emergency (Red) - 0 min
Immediate care. Imminent risk of death.

Very Urgent (Orange) - Up to 10 min
Risk of organ function loss. Very rapid assessment.

Urgent (Yellow) - Up to 60 min
Condition requiring rapid care, no immediate risk.

Standard (Green) - Up to 120 min
Can safely wait for care.

Non-urgent (Blue) - Up to 240 min
Cases of lower complexity. Outpatient management if possible.
